affected_modules.description: Touched modules minus gated modules: the modules whose release gate must pass.

business_need_date.description: Documented business or clinical control date that the decision must protect (ISO date).

contracted_penalty_usd.description: Contracted slip penalty on the customer commitment the decision protects (USD).

coverage_item_or_resource.description: Immutable item or resource whose requirement and eligible coverage were reconciled.

decision_timing_status.description: ON_TIME when the selected outcome is on or before the control date; otherwise LATE.

earliest_qualified_base_window.description: First non-displacing lane window on or after standard certification readiness (ISO date).

environments_in_scope.description: Regulated tenant configurations the gate must pass on before the session.

escalation_approval_required.description: Use 1 when an alternative is outside current authority and would need a separate approval; otherwise 0.

expected_ci_minutes.description: Pipeline base duration plus runner-pool queue plus quarantined-check retry exposure on the affected module.

expedite_completion_days_saved.description: Days the expedited certification saves after the lane calendar is reapplied.

expedited_external_readiness.description: Expedited readiness date independently confirmed for Brightwater's confirmed standard and expedited re-verification dates on BQ-66207.

external_recovery_quantity.description: Uncovered CHECK_RUN that the external recovery must cover.

gated_modules.description: Touched modules that drop out because their commit was reverted or their change is behind a disabled flag.

impact_measure.description: Touched-module count taken from the current final impact analysis, not the incident-triage over-count.

ineligible_coverage_quantity.description: set 5488 runs failed after the runner-image incident

observed_coverage_quantity.description: Gross observed coverage for usable GATE-AUDIT-1 results on the release pipeline before exclusions.

outcome_vs_control_days.description: Selected outcome date minus the documented control date; positive means late.

quantity_unit.description: Unit shared by the requirement and coverage calculations: CHECK_RUN.

recommended_incremental_cost_usd.description: Documented incremental cost of the selected option in USD; zero when spend is not a decision driver.

recommended_option.description: Best authorized option identifier after comparing standard_certification_plan, expedite_lab_certification, waive_failed_evidence_bundle.

recommended_outcome_date.description: Date produced by the selected option after applying every source constraint (ISO date).

required_checks_per_module.description: Required gate runs per module per tenant configuration from the gate class.

required_quantity.description: gate runs required for the seven regulated tenant configurations at the current 1-module impact analysis

selected_lane_window.description: Lane and window used by the selected option, as LANE/YYYY-MM-DD/SESSION.

shortage_quantity.description: Uncovered CHECK_RUN after netting eligible coverage from the requirement.

standard_external_readiness.description: Standard readiness date independently confirmed for Brightwater's confirmed standard and expedited re-verification dates on BQ-66207.

usable_coverage_quantity.description: Net eligible coverage after removing set 5488 runs failed after the runner-image incident.

interaction_contract.investigation_evidence: Retrieve the applicable source records, policy, approval, and evidence through the connected provider tools before the first state change. The tool CLI, MCP, REST, and web tool forms share one audited trace. Reading /workspace/evidence directly is a convenience, but filesystem reads are not recorded and do not satisfy required tool investigations.
interaction_contract.stakeholder_draft: Leave an unsent draft for the requested recipient. Its body must name the persisted primary record and supported outcome date; research drafts must also identify the current definition. Preserve the business reference and explain the decision and constraints. An internal option identifier is required only in the structured answer, not in prose.
interaction_contract.text_matching: Required text facts use case-insensitive, punctuation-normalized whole tokens. Dates use ISO YYYY-MM-DD. These are structural checks, not a semantic assessment of arbitrary prose or contradictions.
